io.github.thatgarlicdude.pacromset.manifest

Class PacROMSetManifest

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thatgarlicdude.pacromset.manifest.PacROMSetManifest

  • public final class PacROMSetManifest
extends java.lang.Object
    A class that represents a Pac-Man ROM set manifest.

    A Pac-Man ROM set manifest is a type of manifest that has six categorized lists that contain entries called a PacROMSetManifestEntry. Those lists are program, graphic, color, palette, sound, and mystery. Without these lists, there's no way of telling which ROM in a Pac-Man ROM set is considered a program ROM or a graphic ROM. The entries in a list do not contain copyrighted data, but they are used to find and work with specific, expected ROMs found in a Pac-Man ROM set.

    In addition, the class contains other data, like MAGIC used for reading and writing .pacromsetmanifest files, EXTENSION for labeling files that have the .pacromsetmanifest file extension, and VERSION to indicate what version the manifest class is on.

    A Pac-Man ROM set manifest can be written to disk via the PacROMSetManifestWriter class, or can be read from disk via the PacROMSetManifestReader class. Alternatively, they can easily be saved or loaded from the PacROMSetManifests class, an easy gateway for working with manifests.

    Since:
    1.0.0
    See Also:
    PacROMSetManifestEntry, PacROMSetManifests, PacROMSetManifestReader, PacROMSetManifestWriter

    • Field Detail

      • MAGIC

        public static final java.lang.String MAGIC
        The magic signature found at the beginning of a .pacromsetmanifest file.

        This field is used to identify whether a file is truly a Pac-Man ROM set manifest file. It is written at the start of a file whenever it is being saved to disk. When the file is being loaded from disk, it must look for that signature before proceeding to the other contents. That being said, the magic signature is used to make sure whether a file is actually a Pac-Man ROM set manifest file.

        Alternatively, the field can be obtained by calling the getMagic() method, which returns this value.

        Since:
        1.0.0
        See Also:
        getMagic(), EXTENSION, Constant Field Values

      • EXTENSION

        public static final java.lang.String EXTENSION
        The file extension for a .pacromsetmanifest file.

        This field is used to label files as Pac-Man ROM set manifest files, not to be confused with MAGIC, which identifies them as one. This is especially useful for UI classes like JFileChooser and JFileFilter, since they can filter files using this file extension.

        Alternatively, the field can be obtained by calling the getExtension() method, which returns this value.

        Since:
        1.0.0
        See Also:
        getExtension(), MAGIC, Constant Field Values

      • VERSION

        public static final byte VERSION
        The current version of the Pac-Man ROM set manifest.

        This field is used to identify what version the ROM set manifest is on. It is also written and read next to the MAGIC when a .pacromsetmanifest file is being accessed from the system's disk. It is especially important because, in the future, the JPacROMSetManifest Java library may change or introduce things to the manifest and its entries. The system should not be confused on what type of Pac-Man ROM set manifest it is trying to read or write onto disk.

        Alternatively, the field can be obtained by calling the getVersion() method, which returns the value.

        Since:
        1.0.0
        See Also:
        getVersion(), Constant Field Values

        Constructs an instance of the PacROMSetManifest class.

        When constructing an instance of this class, the lists cannot point to null. If that happens, it will throw an error, saying that a list is null.

        Parameters:
        programList - The list that holds program ROM entries.
        graphicList - The list that holds graphic ROM entries.
        colorList - The list that holds color ROM entries.
        paletteList - The list that holds palette ROM entries.
        soundList - The list that holds sound ROM entries.
        mysteryList - The list that holds mystery ROM entries.
        Throws:
        java.lang.NullPointerException - When one of the lists are null.

      • getProgramList

        public final java.util.List<PacROMSetManifestEntry> getProgramList()
        Gets the program list of the Pac-Man ROM set manifest.

        The program list is a List object that can hold PacROMSetManifestEntry instances, which are the ROM entries. These instances do not contain any ROM data, but they do have expected filenames and file sizes found in a Pac-Man ROM set.

        Returns:
        A List that can hold program ROM entries.
        Since:
        1.0.0
